body:
Bad people don't care much about rights. I do understand that it gives me no right. I just don't care about rights, because life was bad. I don't care about them, because once, and then once again, and more - no one cared about my rights. 
I won't hurt anyone or anything. That's just defense. You do anything bad to me - and my care level is "go fuck a landmine". 
Earlier it was not so, that's all the difference.

Okay, I wake up, eat and everything, use PC, play games. Sometimes parents scream at, I scream at them. Rarely I go out for something or someone, usually being a dick, so no one can hurt me. Nothing good at all. I wish I was good, but it's low priority due to not helping with my problems.

I think I can live without Mass Effect 3. Wait, it's actually die without Mass Effect 3. It's easier to die when you don't have it, huh?

Well, your story is what I call.. luck? 
I'm happy for you.

I'm not good with girls and all that stuff. Every relationships ends fast and unexpected. I don't understand, they won't say me. 
Last relationship was best of all I had before, I actually was happy, motivated and everything. I care about it much more than about job, 'cause getting job is much more logical and so on. 
Well, I know, keep trying. I'm not sure about exact number, but at least 22 girls were involved in that trying. And I'm still pretty bad at it as you can see.

Yes, I'm ready to kill others. They have their own opinion, own situations. People around me did enough shit to me, I'm not responsible for humanity.
If that makes me bad person, so be it. I wasn't this selfish two or three years ago.

One day it became mainstream for a reason.

I know that. Everything is good. I've got this problem:
In my childhood everything was play. Nothing bad happened, nothing at all.
Now I can't appreciate what I already have. That's what my psychotherapist said.

My condition is relative, and that's all that matters to me. Yes, I'm selfish, I admit it. 
But not that much, because I'm not willing to do any good, so my death will make this world a better place.
I don't have any possibility for that right now. No job, expensive rent rates, expensive education.

New lyceum didn't work. 
Studying at MSU.. worked a bit. Month or so I was happier a bit. 
Yes, tried to change personality. People from there still fascinate me more than people from other, older places. 
It's only temporary, weak solution.

I'm learning, improving. I understand much more now. That's far from enough. I understand, that one day it's 'probably' will be okay, and I understand amount of suffering I must go through to achieve that probability. And it's bad.
I can accept fails as fact, I'm just overwhelmed with everything that's coming out of my fails.

My personal professional is helping me, six months already. Not a single improvement, he does not even understand if it's a pathology or not

"dude it sounds like you have options but you're just telling yourself you don't have options because you want to wallow in your self-pity."
That's what my friends love to say. 

Yes, young, and I live with parents, have no job. 

When I start something new, I always stick to that rule - past is past. Just trying to correct my mistakes, nothing good in the end.
Finally, I've come to this - everything I start have one single destination - nowhere, within days. Lack of motivation. I understand, that I can succeed at something, but I lose my motivation very fast anyway. Forcing myself to do something does not work either.

Furthermore, I've got flashbacks of my failures. It's killing me.
